tooMany: More than 10,000 documents match. Narrow the filter or the period down.
unexportable: A document cannot be exported to the accounting program. Fix it or narrow the export down (period, documents).
empty: There are no documents in the period.

list.hint: Every document of the current tab and filters, without drafts and cancelled ones. The file can be imported back.

accountant.title: Export for the accountant
accountant.intro: Issued and received tax documents (no proformas) whose tax date falls in the period, as one file — CSV, or XML for import into an accounting program. Drafts and cancelled documents are left out.
accountant.periodHint: Tax date (received: tax date, else received date); at most 366 days.

formatHints.csv: Document header and VAT summary in CZK; the file can be imported back.
formatHints.pohoda: Pohoda XML uses the accounting codes, VAT classifications and number series from Settings → Accounting.
